generated from it — add a project, a skill group or a role here and the
page picks it up on the next build. No component changes required.
Formatting you can use inside any title or statement line:
*word*  → sets that word in the editorial italic serif
|       → forces a line break (section titles only)
Numbering is automatic. Projects are numbered 01, 02, 03… in the order
they appear below; skill groups are lettered A, B, C… the same way.

projects.title: Mock Pitch Voice Agent
projects.summary: A real-time voice agent that runs investor Q&A sessions, so founders can rehearse the pitch before it counts.
projects.problem: Founders get one shot at an investor conversation and almost no way to rehearse the unscripted half of it — the questions. The system simulates that pressure: it listens, interrogates, adapts, and reports back.
approach: Agentic conversation flow built on LangChain and LangGraph, handling context-aware questioning, evaluation and adaptive branching as the pitch develops.
Speech-to-text via Whisper and text-to-speech via ElevenLabs, wired into a continuous real-time loop rather than a turn-based transcript.
FastAPI backend with WebSocket streaming to keep round-trip latency low enough for the exchange to feel conversational.
Conversation data persisted and analysed in MongoDB, turning each session into performance tracking and feedback signal.
Containerised with Docker and deployed on GCP Cloud Run, with a modular architecture that keeps new capabilities additive.

projects.title: Founder–Investor Matching Engine
projects.summary: A semantic matching system that ranks the investors most likely to fund a given founder, from embeddings rather than keywords.
projects.problem: Founder–investor fit is a semantic problem wearing a search-box disguise. Keyword filters miss thesis alignment; the engine reasons over profiles instead of matching strings.
approach: LangChain and LangGraph pipelines covering query understanding, ranking logic and multi-agent reasoning to improve match quality beyond a single similarity pass.
FAISS vector index retrieving the top 100 candidate investors per founder profile from contextual embeddings.
FastAPI backend with WebSocket streaming, keeping the interaction responsive as results resolve.
Match results stored in MongoDB so investor–founder interactions can be tracked, filtered and analysed over time.
Containerised with Docker and deployed on GCP Cloud Run for production-ready scale.

projects.title: ArXiv Research Agent
projects.summary: A multi-agent research assistant that retrieves, summarises and answers questions across ArXiv papers.
projects.problem: Keeping current with a fast-moving field is a retrieval problem and a comprehension problem at once. Splitting those across specialised agents produces better answers than asking one model to do both.
approach: Multi-agent architecture in AutoGen, with separate agents collaborating on retrieval and on summarisation.
LLM-driven paper understanding, distilled into concise outputs written for a reader rather than a benchmark.
Interactive Streamlit interface producing structured results in JSON and Markdown for downstream use.
Containerised with Docker and published on Hugging Face Spaces for public access and reproducibility.

projects.title: DataAnalyzerAI
projects.summary: Upload a CSV or JSON file, ask a question in plain language, and get back executed analysis with charts.
projects.problem: The distance between having data and understanding it is usually a Python session. This collapses that into a sentence.
approach: AutoGen multi-agent system that accepts CSV/JSON uploads and interprets natural-language queries against them.
Agents generate, execute and return Python code, producing analysis and graph visualisations without user intervention.
End-to-end exploration tool with reproducible results, packaged through Dockerised deployment.
